dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: Hello there. The potions from earlier have sold out.

dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: I've organized the sales data for you. Feel free to have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: Let's skip right to talking about this deal, shall we?

response.speaker: Atefeh
response.text: According to my keen market sense, these are the kinds of potions that are currently in demand.

response.speaker: Atefeh
response.text: Hmm, okay. But don't wait too long. When it comes to making Mora, you've got to strike while the iron is hot!
